newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING Bank seeks Brussels bourse remote membership.
newsitem.headline: ING Bank seeks Brussels bourse remote membership.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Friday its ING Bank (Amsterdam) unit has asked to become a full associated, or remote, member of the Brussels Stock Exchange.
It said ING Bank would be the first active player in international securities markets to take advantage of the full implementation under Belgian law of the European Directives on Investment Services.
The bank is a member of the Amsterdam Stock Exchange and the EOE options exchange and a remote market maker on the Deutsche Terminborse (DTB).
Remote members can operate directly in another country's securities market via a secured and computerised link, making cross border trading and investment as easy as for local members.
